name: lidocaine + thymol
purpose: Active ingredient Purpose Lidocaine HCl Monohydrate 4% Topical Analgesic Thymol 0.063% First Aid Antiseptic
uses: Use For the temporary relief of pain and to guard against infection.
otcwarn: Do not use in large quantities, particularly over raw surfaces or blistered areas. if you are allergic to any ingredient in this product. if you have an injury or perforation (hole) of the eardrum or tubes in the ear. If conditions worsen, or if symptoms persist for more than 7 days or clear up and occur again within a few days, discontinue use of this product and consult a doctor.
